title: Seahawks WR Tory Horton could return before offseason work is done

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Seahawks WR Tory Horton could return before offseason work is done
sources.description: Wide receiver Tory Horton, a fifth-round pick in 2025, made 13 catches for 161 yards and five touchdowns and also contributed a 95-yard punt return touchdown.
